blurb: West Island Marina provides boat slips and moorings with amenities including 30/50 Amp hookups, fresh water, and Wi-Fi. They offer secure outdoor winter storage with no height restrictions, suitable for large vessels and sailboats with masts up. The property is gated and monitored by security cameras, allowing customers to work on their boats and welcoming subcontractors at no extra cost.
